  • Prime Location:


Situated in Sidi Heneish, one of the most coveted destinations in Sahel, Beit Al Bahr benefits from its proximity to beautiful beaches. This prime location enhances the appeal of the investment, as properties in sought-after areas tend to maintain and increase their value over time.

 













  • Uninterrupted Stunning Views:


Units at Beit Al Bahr offer uninterrupted, stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea. The breathtaking vistas create an inviting atmosphere, allowing residents to enjoy the beauty of nature right from their homes, which significantly enhances the living experience and property value.

 










  • Privacy:


The design of Beit Al Bahr prioritizes privacy, ensuring that residents can enjoy their vacation without distractions. This focus on creating a serene environment adds to the appeal of the investment, particularly for those looking for a peaceful retreat.

 











  • Secured Project:

  • Unique and Luxurious Design:


The project boasts a unique and luxurious design that reflects sophistication and elegance.

El Abd: The pioneer who first recognized the potential of Sidi Heneish Bay as the North Coast’s Crown Jewel over three decades ago, laying the foundation for one of Sahel’s most prestigious and iconic communities.

The name "Sidi Heneish" holds cultural significance, with "Sidi" translating to master or lord, while "Heneish" means baby snake. This intriguing nomenclature adds depth to the region's identity, reflecting its rich heritage and connection to the natural world.


Overall, Sidi Heneish stands out as a premier destination in North Coast, attracting those looking for luxury, leisure, and a serene beach experience.

Besides the innovative design, Trio New Cairo Compound by M Squared is well known for its wide range of amenities, offering a luxurious life. Combine that with the endless greenery and shimmering water features, and you get the recipe for a perfect life in the heart of New Cairo City. 


Trio New Cairo Compound Master Plan


Trio New Cairo Compound is a high-end compound developed by M Squared across 35.5 acres of land in New Cairo to be a true testament to sustainable development. Accordingly, it is filled with lush greenery, parks, and gardens. 


In fact, all buildings are connected with open gardens, water features, and fully functional parks. It is also worth mentioning that 75% of the compound’s area is dedicated to parks, gardens, fountains, bike tracks, and walking trails. 


Besides the open spaces and elements of nature, Trio New Cairo Compound New Cairo features a wide range of facilities, including but not limited to:


  • Clubhouse: Featuring indoor and outdoor loungers, a nursery, a kids’ area, a swimming pool, a gym, and a spa and wellness center, the clubhouse has everything you need and more. 


  • Commercial Arcade: The Commercial Arcade is the thriving hub of Trio, featuring various retail shops, offices, and a diverse food court. Whether it’s dining, shopping, or business you are looking for, this is where you will go. 


  • Fitness Zone: For all sports enthusiasts, the Fitness Zone will be your haven where you can break a sweat and maintain your shape while enjoying the breathtaking scenery. 


  • Meditation Zone: On the other hand, for those who like to relax and meditate, this zone is for you.

 

  • Yoga Garden: Yogis and yoga enthusiasts will have the time of their lives doing yoga in the fresh air. 


  • Barbeque Area: Nothing says fun in the outdoors more than a BBQ. Gather your loved ones and enjoy a hearty meal in the sun at the dedicated barbecue area. 


  • Seating Area: Whether you like to spend your time alone, with friends, or with family, the seating area amidst nature in Trio is the perfect space for some outdoor time. 


  • Kids Play Zone: Your kids will have a blast, make new friends, and create happy memories with you in the kids' play zone.

On a mission to offer the most convenient living experience, M Square Developments strategically chose the location of Trio New Cairo Compound in a prime spot in the Fifth Settlement, New Cairo City. 


To sum up, Trio New Cairo Compound has all your basic necessities and plenty of leisure activities for you to indulge in within its gates.  Forget getting stuck in traffic for hours just to get some groceries or having to plan your vacation days and weeks to find something to do. Because in Trio, everything you need is just around the corner. 


Keep in mind that the ideal Trio New Cairo location is in proximity to Al Ahly Sporting Club, Geziera Club, and only:

Properties in Trio New Cairo Compound


The units available in Trio New Cairo vary between luxurious standalone villas, twin houses, townhouses, apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and offices. Each property type comes in many shapes and sizes to ensure you can easily find your dream home. 


Keep in mind that all properties in Trio Compound are delivered with a smart home system. This means that you have full control over your house’s security lights, doors, windows, curtains, and air conditioning, as well as audio and visual systems wherever you are. 


In other terms, it doesn’t matter if you are home or not; at any minute, you can control everything at your place from your mobile phone.


Why Will You Love Trio New Cairo Compound? 


Trio New Cairo Compound is considered one of the top residential developments in the city for many reasons. On top of that list comes the ideal location in New Cairo, the endless greenery, the wide array of amenities, and the elegant properties. 


But what really sets Trio New Cairo apart from other residential gated communities is its smart homes and sustainable solutions. 


M Squared was keen on offering a healthy living environment in Trio New Cairo. That’s why it respected the area’s natural surroundings and introduced a number of sustainable solutions to save energy and enhance the quality of life. 


The sustainable efforts and smart solutions found in the Trio New Cairo Project include, but are not limited to:

  • Energy saving systems

Architectural Design of Trio New Cairo Compound 


Trio New Cairo Compound has a mesmerizing design with a perfect blend of modern architecture and natural scenery.  So everywhere you look, you are greeted with endless greenery, yet you are living in a futuristic home with cutting-edge smart solutions. 


It is worth mentioning that Trio New Cairo is equipped with ramps and the correct width requirements to enable free-flowing movements of wheelchairs and mobility devices. This means that the compound is designed with ultimate accessibility in mind.

M Squared Developments, also known as M2 Developments, has been a leading real estate developer operating since 1998. The company focuses on creating high-quality projects in Egypt’s top areas. 


On a mission to be the top real estate developer, M Squared focuses on certain values, including timely deliveries, maximum ROI, never-ending after-sales services, and convenient payment terms. With those values in mind, M Squared has successfully established numerous projects, including but not limited to:

New Cairo City is a relatively new city in East Cairo, sprawled across 70,000 acres of land. The city is home to many international schools, universities, commercial areas, shopping malls, and medical facilities. This allows residents to have everything they need just around the corner. 




With ongoing expansion and infrastructure projects, New Cairo is expected to play a significant role in Egypt’s economic future, offering a modern lifestyle for its residents and promoting Cairo’s overall urban development goals.
